Every clock in town just froze at midnight. And you're the only one moving.
Last time, a voice that sounded exactly like you knocked three times.

text: You don't open. You hold your breath. The knocking stops.

You peek outside. Every streetlight is off.
Your neighbour is stuck mid-step, one foot in the air. He doesn't blink.
Your phone says midnight. So does the oven. Nothing is ticking.
Then a new text from your own number. Find Mia. She's awake too.
Who is Mia? And your battery just dropped to four percent.

text: Across the street, a flashlight blinks back at you.
Would you go outside? Comment yes or no.
